build_graph_break: build a torch.compile model that uses comptime.graph_break() to split the FX graph at a specific point
create_print_graph: create a torch.compile model that uses comptime.print_graph() to inspect the partially constructed FX graph
test_print_locals: test the comptime.print_locals() API to print compile-time local variables during torch.compile
review_print_bt: review the comptime.print_bt() API to print the compilation backtrace during torch.compile
summarize_breakpoint: summarize the comptime.breakpoint() API for interactive pdb debugging during torch.compile compilation
